title: Correct one confirmed defect
authority: Inspect and modify only the files required for the stated defect; local validation, commit, and push are allowed; protected actions are not authorized.
out_of_scope: Neighboring cleanup, redesign, deployment, release, history rewrite.
task: Implement the smallest correction that restores the violated contract.
validation: Run the smallest deterministic test that proves the contract, then relevant regressions.
artifacts: Task result and relevant test evidence.
stop_conditions: Stop on live-state mismatch, authority ambiguity, secret exposure, or scope expansion.
success_criteria: The confirmed defect is corrected on the exact tested SHA with attributable evidence.
